title: Education loan and personal loan — what to know before borrowing
publisher: Artha Kavach summary of public guidance (RBI / SEBI / IRDAI / Income Tax Dept) — pending manual verification
text: An education loan usually has the lowest interest among loans for individuals, a moratorium (no EMI) during the course plus a grace period, and interest paid is deductible under Section 80E for up to 8 years in the old regime. A personal loan is unsecured and costly (often 11–24% a year depending on your profile) and should be used for genuine needs, not lifestyle spends. Before borrowing: borrow the smallest amount you need, compare at least three lenders on APR and total cost, avoid instant-loan apps that are not RBI-regulated, and never take a loan to invest or to repay a card without a clear plan. Check that the lender is a bank or an RBI-registered NBFC, and that the loan amount is credited to your own bank account.
summary_hinglish: Education loan sabse sasta loan hota hai, course ke dauran EMI nahi (moratorium) aur interest par 80E ki chhoot (old regime). Personal loan mehnga hai (11-24%), isliye sirf zaroorat par lo. Kam se kam 3 lenders compare karo, RBI-registered bank/NBFC se hi lo.
summary_hi: एजुकेशन लोन सबसे सस्ते लोनों में है, कोर्स के दौरान EMI नहीं (मोरेटोरियम) और ब्याज पर 80E की छूट (पुराने रिजीम में)। पर्सनल लोन महंगा है (11-24%), इसलिए सिर्फ़ ज़रूरत पर लें। कम से कम 3 ऋणदाताओं की तुलना करें और RBI-पंजीकृत बैंक/NBFC से ही लें।
